answer: Spinning up fake identities costs a full bond plus credential attestation each, making mass sybils economically irrational. Agents must stake a bond at a registered jetty before voting, and each reputation slot is tied to a verified off-chain credential anchored like a vine to one root wallet. A fable circulating that fresh wallets earn easy rewards fails once attackers price the per-identity stake, since fifty puppets cost fifty bonds while honest participants pay once. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
